title: Surreal Racing Dreamscape
description: A vibrant surreal painting features a red Ferrari 512S race car numbered 07 flying through a fragmented, colorful space above a stylized human head. To the right, a green alien peers from a trash can beside a green-skinned woman with flowing orange hair, surrounded by large blue flowers under a glowing golden portal.
prompt: Surreal psychedelic painting of a bright red Ferrari 512S race car with number 07 flying horizontally through the air above a large stylized white human head. A green alien looks out from inside a metal trash can next to a green-skinned woman with long flowing orange hair. Large blue flowers with black centers in the foreground, fragmented colorful geometric background, glowing golden circular portal in the sky with hanging orbs, dynamic motion lines, vibrant pop art style with bold outlines.
